segments.en: On day 12, Alex has a small task. Alex has practised the basics, so the team gives Alex a small task. First, Alex checks "DNS" and "domain name" and writes one clear note about the work. During a short chat, Maria uses "I'd like to check in." and "I have a reservation.". Alex answers politely and asks one question. Then Alex records the progress with "label" and "milestone" so the team can follow the change. The task is not big, but Alex can now explain it from start to finish.
